name: Poltergeist
tagline: A spectral effects processor that haunts, warps, and decays
summary: A real-time phase vocoder that deconstructs audio into spectral frames and rebuilds it — pitch shifting, frequency warping, comb resonance, and a frequency-domain Ghost Delay with gated feedback.

highlights.title: Phase Vocoder Spectral Engine
highlights.body: A real-time STFT phase vocoder deconstructs audio into frequency-domain frames, transforms magnitude and phase directly, then resynthesizes. Two modes: High Resolution (1024-sample window) for maximum detail, Low Latency (512-sample) for tighter response.

highlights.title: Ghost Delay
highlights.body: The defining feature — a frame delay that stores and replays entire spectral frames rather than audio samples. Echoes repeat with full pitch fidelity, without the smearing of conventional delays.

highlights.title: Spectral Warp & Shift with Morph Crossfade
highlights.body: Spectral Shift applies a Bode-style linear frequency offset, dissolving harmonic relationships into metallic, inharmonic textures. Spectral Warp remaps the frequency axis nonlinearly, stretching lows against highs for formant-like and alien vocal transformations. Morph crossfades continuously between them.

highlights.title: Spectral Gate
highlights.body: Rhythmic gating across the Ghost Delay, from 20 ms tremolo flutter to two-second pulses, with an intensity ramp and tempo sync to your DAW.

highlights.title: Bode Frequency Shift on the Feedback Path
highlights.body: Each delay repetition is frequency-shifted again, so echoes drift progressively further from the source — accumulating spectral drift that spirals rather than repeats.

highlights.title: Spectral Wavefold & Comb Filter
highlights.body: A spectral-domain wavefold stage adds harmonic grit directly to the spectral data, feeding a resonant spectral comb filter for metallic, tuned resonance.

specs: Pitch shift, wavefold, comb, shift/warp, frame delay, gate
Parameter morphing crossfader, tempo sync, host automation
Factory banks plus unlimited user presets
requirements: A DAW that supports VST3 plugins (or AU on macOS)
macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later (Intel or Apple Silicon), Windows, or Linux
Multi-core CPU recommended when visualization is enabled
audience: Sound designers and producers working in spectral territory — granular and glitch textures, cinematic transitions, haunted ambience, and impossible vocal transformations.
